decisions.statement: A body names the type its page answers to and satisfies the type.
A body is exported under the name its slug becomes.
The keys are written in the order the caller names the keys.
A key the caller names and the values do not carry is left out.
A key the values have and the caller does not name is answered rather than written.
A value is written as JSON.
The file a body names its type from is written as a quoted literal is.
A body composed here parses whatever characters that file's path carries.
Only data JSON has may be a value.
A key inside a value is written bare where TypeScript reads the key bare.
Nothing here formats the body this module wrote.
The landing mints and formats the body.
A page names its type from the root rather than by a relative path.

definition: the TypeScript a page is, written from the values it has
